title: Luscious Smoky German Peppers Skewers
description: A dense and flavorful German dish featuring smoky peppers, this recipe is perfect for those looking for a show-stopping meal that is also diabetic-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast, bell peppers, and onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the chicken, peppers, and onion onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
After 5 minutes of grilling, add the minced garlic to the skewers and continue grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
